events.verdict: Adebayo (MIA) establishes himself as he firms up in Conley's (UTA) path and absorbs the incidental contact during the pick.
Herro (MIA) moves toward Markkanen's (UTA) path, causing both players to come together and separate during the drive. The contact is marginal.
Adebayo (MIA) does not maintain a legal guarding position when he jumps into Markkanen (UTA) during his driving shot attempt.
Kessler (UTA) cleanly deflects the ball from Adebayo (MIA), and any ensuing contact is incidental.
Vincent (MIA) moves toward Conley's (UTA) path, causing marginal contact to occur as they come together and separate in the backcourt.
Herro (MIA) makes incidental high-five contact with Markkanen (UTA) after the release of his shot attempt near the rim.
Oladipo (MIA) is veering back toward Olynyk's (UTA) path to create the marginal contact that occurs on the perimeter.
Olynyk (UTA) and Oladipo (MIA) make simultaneous contact with the ball, and a jump ball is correctly called.
Strus (MIA) retracts a resting hand from Markkanen's (UTA) body during the long rebound.
Strus (MIA) initiates contact with Clarkson's (UTA) arm, affecting his shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) grabs Kessler's (UTA) left arm, affecting his ability to secure the rebound.
Conley (UTA) is in Herro's (MIA) path when marginal body contact occurs in the backcourt.
Markkanen (UTA) commits a take foul on Adebayo (MIA). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Markkanen (UTA) briefly grasps Strus's (MIA) jersey and immediately releases it as marginal contact occurs during the pursuit of the rebound.
Vincent (MIA) initiates contact with Clarkson's (UTA) lower body during his upward shooting motion.
Conley (UTA) reaches in and comes across Oladipo's (MIA) arm, which affects his layup attempt.
Vincent (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball to partially dislodge it from Markkanen (UTA) during the rebound.
Highsmith (MIA) is established in Markkanen's (UTA) path and absorbs the body contact as Markkanen loses control of the ball on the perimeter.
Highsmith (MIA) reaches in and initiates contact with Markkanen's (UTA) left arm during his upward shooting motion.
Clarkson (UTA) moves alongside Herro's (MIA) path and maintains a legal guarding position while contesting the shot attempt.
